decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's existing web analytics expertise and meets the GA4 migration demand, so the firm can interpret early feedback and improve the plugin.
Universal Analytics has been discontinued by Google, leaving no future market or learning opportunity for this plugin.
The plugin leverages the firm's integration and programming capabilities, allowing it to assimilate client feedback and refine the interface.
The dedicated page and the firm's SEO know-how indicate a strong fit with existing capabilities and the ability to learn from early results.
